transactions.desc: The Red Sox reinstated Kiner-Falefa (forearm) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.
The Cardinals selected Rincon's contract from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Cardinals recalled Bernal from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Cardinals recalled Scott from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Dodgers recalled Freeland from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
Atlanta selected Farmer's contract from Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
Atlanta selected Burkhalter's contract from Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
Woods Richardson was sent outright to Triple-A Buffalo on Monday.
The Orioles designated Vazquez for assignment Monday.
Arizona optioned Fernandez to Triple-A Reno on Monday.
The Cardinals optioned Crooks to Triple-A Memphis on Monday.
The Marlins recalled Gibson from Triple-A Jacksonville on Monday.
The Marlins optioned Gonzalez to Triple-A Jacksonville on Monday.
The Marlins recalled Serna from Triple-A Jacksonville on Monday.
Texas recalled Peoples from Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
The Rangers recalled Ahlstrom from Triple-A Round Rock on Monday.
The Tampa Bay Rays traded OF Jake Cave to the Chicago White Sox.
The Diamondbacks activated Marte (knee) from the 10-day injured list Monday, Alex Weiner of ArizonaSports.com reports.
The Tigers optioned Julks to Triple-A Toledo on Monday.
The Tigers designated Rainey for assignment Monday.
The Tigers recalled Diaz from Triple-A Toledo on Monday.
The Tigers selected Peck's contract from Triple-A Toledo on Monday.
The Brewers activated Uribe (forearm) from the 15-day injured list Monday.
The Mariners activated Criswell (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Monday.
The Mets activated Vientos (hand) from the 10-day injured list Monday. He'll start at designated hitter and bat cleanup in the series opener versus the Rays.
The Orioles optioned Nunez to Triple-A Norfolk on Monday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
The Orioles recalled Povich from Triple-A Norfolk and will have him start Monday's game against the Rockies in Denver, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
The Red Sox recalled Gasper from Triple-A Worcester on Monday, and he'll start at first base and bat second in the team's series opener versus the Mariners.
The Philadelphia Phillies traded OF Tommy Pham to the Chicago White Sox.
The Mets recalled Morabito from Triple-A Syracuse on Monday, Will Sammon of The Athletic reports.
